name: NYX Sports & Active Lifestyle Mobile Application
desc: A feature-rich Flutter app that brings sports retail, facility reservations, training enrollment, tournament information, and account management together in one platform, backed by REST APIs.

responsibilities.title: Mobile UI Development
responsibilities.description: Built reusable Flutter widgets and responsive screens for the dashboard, catalog, cart, facility rentals, training, tournaments, and account management.

responsibilities.title: E-commerce
responsibilities.description: Implemented product and category browsing, tag filters, product details, cart quantity and stock validation, totals, checkout, and order history.

responsibilities.title: Facility Booking
responsibilities.description: Created venue and court discovery, availability and time-slot selection, reservations, walk-in booking, payment selection, and booking history.

responsibilities.title: Training and Tournaments
responsibilities.description: Integrated training discovery and enrollment with payment workflows, plus tournament details, schedules, rankings, and enrollment.

responsibilities.title: REST API Integration
responsibilities.description: Connected authentication, profiles, product catalogs, training, tournaments, bookings, payment methods, and order processing to backend APIs.

responsibilities.title: Architecture
responsibilities.description: Used a feature-first, layered structure, applying Clean Architecture in selected modules with repositories, domain entities, use cases, and remote data sources.

responsibilities.title: State Management
responsibilities.description: Used Provider and ChangeNotifier for shared services and feature controllers, with Cubits for catalog, recommendations, and checkout workflows.

responsibilities.title: Authentication and Sessions
responsibilities.description: Implemented registration, login, OTP verification, password recovery, profile updates, and local session management with SharedPreferences.

responsibilities.title: Error Handling
responsibilities.description: Added shared API error handling, user-facing messages, loading states, and retryable error views for network and data-fetching failures.

responsibilities.title: Device Integration
responsibilities.description: Integrated image selection, screenshot capture, content sharing, runtime permissions, and external URL launching with Flutter plugins.

responsibilities.title: Automated Testing and CI/CD
responsibilities.description: Configured GitHub Actions for formatting checks, static analysis, tests, and Android APK builds uploaded as workflow artifacts.

responsibilities.title: Maintainability and Testing
responsibilities.description: Organized features into separate modules and added tests for selected shop catalog and checkout Cubit behavior, plus a startup widget smoke test.

name: Daily Need Items - Microservices Marketplace
desc: A production-grade marketplace spanning e-commerce, food delivery, and ride-hailing. Designed with independently deployable services, asynchronous workflows, and resilient cross-service communication.

name: Banking Management System
desc: A secure banking platform using domain-driven design and clean architecture, with validated REST APIs and a React Native mobile client for end-to-end banking workflows.

name: Employment Management System
desc: A modular workforce platform with automated payroll, PDF payslip generation, multi-level leave approvals, role-based access, and optimized reporting queries.

name: Training Management System
desc: An enterprise learning platform for course management, student enrollment, QR attendance, payments, reporting, notifications, and automated certification.

name: CQRS Clean Architecture Portfolio
desc: A full-stack platform separating MySQL write operations from MongoDB read models, synchronized with RabbitMQ and exposed through GraphQL.

name: GiveMM – Charity Crowdfunding Platform
desc: A full-stack Laravel web application that empowers users to create and manage charity fundraising campaigns. Features include secure local (KPay, WavePay) and international (Stripe) donation processing, real-time progress tracking, role-based access control for admins and users, and a clean UI built with Blade and Bootstrap.

name: Daily Fair Deal
desc: A multi-service marketplace platform that combines food delivery, e-commerce, and ride-hailing with real-time features like driver tracking. Developed with a modular structure supporting vendors, customers, and drivers. Includes Stripe, WavePay, and KPay payments and real-time Socket.IO communication.

name: Real Estate Management System
desc: A backend-driven property management platform using Laravel and RESTful APIs. Includes secure user registration, Google/Facebook social logins, property posting, booking system, and review/rating features. APIs are secured with JWT and Laravel Passport.

name: Yummy Restaurant System
desc: A scalable restaurant management platform built with PHP and MySQL. Enables customers to browse categorized menus, add items to a cart, and place orders. Admin dashboard includes full CRUD operations for menu, user, and order management using an intuitive AdminLTE interface.

name: Media Library
desc: A Laravel-based content management system for books, movies, and music. Offers user registration, media categorization, advanced search functionality, and an admin panel for content moderation and CRUD management. Built with Blade templating and Bootstrap.

name: Job Board
desc: A job listing and application portal using Laravel, Livewire, and Tailwind CSS. Users can register, post jobs, and apply, while admins manage listings. Features include authentication with Laravel Fortify and dynamic interactivity using Livewire.
